title: Licence perimeter & identity
maintains: Current licence, product/funds-flow review, identity display evidence, office evidence.

title: Governance & fitness
maintains: Governance records, current persons, adverse-information review and linked event history.

title: NDT prudential portfolio
maintains: Classification, accrued-interest controls, provisioning, write-offs and early-warning evidence.

title: Pricing & interest calculations
maintains: Pricing configuration, test cases, exception reports and approved product sheets.

title: Price disclosure & publication
maintains: Pre-contract schedule and channel screenshots/current price publication.

title: Credit assessment & lending contract
maintains: Affordability evidence, contract template, delivery of agreement and renewal pack evidence.

title: Borrower transaction rights
maintains: Cooling-off/settlement/receipt controls and borrower information-request workflow evidence.

title: Guarantor controls
maintains: Guarantor explanation, confirmation and consent evidence.

title: Collateral controls
ids: COL-01–COL-03; ML-04 and NDT-04 where applicable
maintains: Collateral type, valuation, custody, register, insurance, demand/sale and proceeds evidence.

title: Collections conduct
maintains: Approved scripts, call/message monitoring, complaints and exception handling.

title: Recovery-agent oversight
maintains: Due diligence, contracts, customer notice, training and monitoring.

title: Credit information sharing
maintains: Consent, reporting file validation, reconciliation and current reporting arrangement.

title: Complaints & fair treatment
maintains: Complaint mechanism, cases, root-cause analysis and fair-treatment controls.

title: Customer information & advertising
maintains: Key facts, regulated-status disclosures, product information and advertisement approval evidence.

title: Statements, account closure & suitability
maintains: Agreed statement cycle, closure notices and suitability records where advice is given.

title: Digital system integrity
maintains: Security testing, release approval, permissions inventory and app/channel evidence.

title: Privacy & data lifecycle
maintains: Data inventory, lawful-use controls, retention/destruction evidence and cross-border assessment.

title: AML governance & programme
maintains: FIA/goAML setup, MLCO, programme, risk assessments, training and audit/remediation.

title: AML customer risk & monitoring
maintains: CDD, beneficial ownership, PEP/high-risk EDD, monitoring and refresh evidence.

title: AML sanctions & dynamic risk
maintains: Current sanctions/high-risk-jurisdiction sources, screening and escalation evidence.

title: AML records & lender funds
maintains: Retention evidence and source-of-funds documentation.
